title: Removing Stars From a String
summary: Given a string containing stars, perform operations to remove each star along with its closest preceding non-star character.
statement: Given a string containing stars, perform operations to remove each star along with its closest preceding non-star character. Return the modified string after all stars are removed, ensuring the process is always possible and the result is unique.
constraints: Every star removes itself and the closest non-star character to its left.
The input guarantees a removable character exists for every star.
Return the final string after all removals.
hints: The closest surviving character to the left is the most recently retained one.
Use a list as a stack of retained characters.
Push letters; on a star, pop the stack top; finally join the stack.
Stack order exactly represents the surviving prefix after each processed character, so each pop performs the required removal.
editorial: Stack order exactly represents the surviving prefix after each processed character, so each pop performs the required removal.
